notes.title: Hotfix January 2nd
notes.content: In this small update, we have fixed a bug, where the achievement "A Road Above the Ground" couldn't be unlocked.

notes.title: Pre-Alpha Demo Update December 20th
notes.content:
Hello, dwarfs! We have brought to you an update, which should hopefully reduce the confusion levels of our players.

What has changed:
[list]
[*] Added a Diary, containing information about the Objectives and Controls, as well as some Hints (this is still Work In Progress, please ignore the visuals of it!)
[*] Added a Map, marking the objectives across the whole level.
[*] Fixed a bug, where Dark Walker couldn't run after viewing a cutscene.
[*] Added a new cutscene near the beginning.
[*] Prolonged the introductory cutscene to show the first objective.
[/list]

We hope you like the changes so far! We are eager to listen to your feedback, so we can do more of them! Don't hesitate to tell us on our [url=https://discord.gg/E8wYbsaPdw]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: The Parvificent Seven Pre-Alpha Demo Is Out!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43101382/168acb7d88aa7ed6db729e26e7f577c02f8eed91.png[/img]

After working hard like dwarfs in a mine, we have finally decided to share our work with you!

With that said, we would like to share our future plans in the following list:

[h1]Roadmap 2023[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improve the visuals of Vision Cone
[*] Improve physics of dead enemies
[*] Add the remaining 4 dwarfs!
[*] Add at least 3 new missions!
[*] Improve the enemy AI
[*] Add more enemies!
[/list]
Excited? Good! We would love to hear from you in our [url=https://discord.gg/E8wYbsaPdw]Discord[/url]! Any form of feedback is very much appreciated.

Have fun!
